title.name: Abraxas
title.subtitle: You wake up in a strange village with no memory

intent.text:
Where you walk and what you say
tell others who you are before your name does.
Stay a while, and go where your heart leads.
intent.note: Choices can't be undone, but none of them are wrong.

howTo.examine: Tap people and things to look closer
howTo.dog: Tap the dog to pet it or call it over
howTo.choose:
Visit the villagers, hear their requests, and choose.
You can't take a choice back, but none of them is wrong.

home-screen: Tap your browser's Share or menu button
Open Abraxas from your home screen to hide the address bar
The home screen version starts from the beginning
open-browser: Tap the menu at the top right
Tap this button again in the browser

nameInput.prompt: What name should I call you by?
nameInput.label: Name
nameInput.error: Please enter a valid name (1-12 characters).

cinematic.fallback: You wake up in the meadow. A small white dog is by your side.

confession.targetPrompt: Choose who to share your feelings with.
confession.reasonPrompt: Why were you drawn to them?

reason.drawn: Because they are different and intriguing
reason.both: Both for our similarities and differences
reason.unsure: Not sure, but drawn all the same

pathBlocked: You can't get there from here.
localExperience: Local experience: this progress is not saved on the server.

result.title: Who you are beyond the shell

reflection.similar: In what ways do we mirror each other?
reflection.drawn: What did we learn from our differences?
reflection.both: How do our similarities and differences blend?
reflection.unsure: What remains at the end of being drawn in?

D.plus: Jumps in for what can be gained

result.disclaimer: This is a psychology game for fun, not a professional assessment.

moments.title: The moments you chose
moments.boundary: Both sides of you showed here.
